abilities.description: You do not yet command this ship, but you desire it. You are crew. Set a progress track, difficulty formidable, and call it “Ascend to Command.” When it is full, flip this card to SIDE B and take command of the ship. Until then, as crew, you select a stat to receive specialized training in. Envision your ship’s commander, your rank, and the Imperial base where you trained, and then add a permanent +1 to either edge, heart, iron, shadow or wits.

Whenever you commit an act of heroism for your ship or crew, you may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.141aec8b92efd14b]{Develop Your Relationship}. On a hit, mark two progress on your “Ascend to Command” track. You also gain the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.a2b30d037d7be39e]{Shields} ship module asset.
If assisted by your crew in anything, take +1.

exclusiveOptions.name: GOZANTI-CLASS ASSAULT CRUISER (+1 to Enter the Fray)
